description:
About the Scholarship

The AskSia AI Literacy Scholarship is an annual essay competition run by AskSia, the team behind an AI study assistant used by students worldwide. The programme asks a genuinely current question: where is the line between using AI to become a stronger learner and quietly becoming dependent on it? Two winners each receive USD 1,500 to put towards tuition, books, living costs or any other study expense. The competition is open to students of any nationality, any field of study and any accredited institution, which makes it one of the most accessible essay awards currently running. Entries for the current round close on 31 December 2026 at 23:59 UTC.

OpportunityAskSia AI Literacy Scholarship 2026
HostAskSia
LocationOnline – open to students worldwide
Study LevelUndergraduate, Master’s (any field)
FundingPartially Funded (one-time award)
AwardUSD 1,500 × 2 winners
Application Deadline31 December 2026, 23:59 UTC
ApplyOfficial scholarship page ↗

Essay Topic and Format

Applicants submit an original essay of 800 to 1,000 words addressing the relationship between productive AI use and AI dependency in student life. The organisers are explicit that essays are judged on the quality of the argument alone — not on formatting, credentials or writing polish. Submissions are checked for authenticity, but the programme states clearly that no AI detectors are used, so a carefully argued, personal and honest essay competes on equal terms with a technically perfect one. Writers are encouraged to draw on their own study habits, real coursework situations and concrete examples rather than abstract speculation about artificial intelligence.

Award Value

Two scholarships of USD 1,500 each are awarded every cycle. The money is paid directly to the winner and can be spent on tuition fees, rent, equipment, conference travel or any other education-related cost — there is no restriction on use. Because the award is a lump sum rather than a maintenance stipend, it stacks cleanly on top of other funding you may already hold, including university scholarships, government loans or part-time work income.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to students of any nationality and any country of residence.
  • Enrolled (or accepted) at an accredited institution, in any field of study.
  • Applicants should be at least 17 years old at the time of entry.
  • One entry per person; the essay must be your own original work.
  • No English-language test, GPA threshold or application fee is required.

How to Apply

The application is completed online through the official AskSia scholarship page. Prepare your essay in advance, fill in the short application form with your details and institution, and attach or paste your essay before the 31 December 2026, 23:59 UTC cut-off. Winners are typically contacted by email within a few weeks of the deadline and announced on the official page. Keep a copy of your submission, and make sure your contact address is one you check regularly — unclaimed awards cannot be reissued after the response window.

Important Notes

Because this is a competitive essay award rather than a needs-based grant, the strongest applications tend to take a clear position and defend it with specific examples of how AI tools change the way the writer studies. Vague optimism or blanket rejection of AI rarely scores well. Check the official page for the current essay prompt, the exact word count rules and any updates to the timeline before you submit.
